title: Provision a new board's .kanbus.yml through kanbus-api
description: Follow-up to kbs-9cb5cb40. A new Chatticus bot board needs its .kanbus.yml in scope <tenant>/<project> before issue routes work (otherwise 503 configuration_missing). Add PUT /{tenant}/{project}/api/config that creates the configuration only if absent (WriteCondition::Absent, idempotent by X-Operation-Id), validates it with the Kanbus configuration loader, and is allowed only for principals holding a provisioning grant (designed together with service principals, kbs-f222b6ee). Spec first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chatticus requirement: PUT /{tenant}/{project}/api/config with an empty body provisions Kanbus's default configuration, generated by the same code as kbs init (hierarchy initiative > epic > task > sub-task; types bug, story, chore; statuses backlog, open, in_progress, blocked, closed; default workflow allows closed -> open). A body supplies a custom .kanbus.yml instead. Both create-if-absent and idempotent by X-Operation-Id.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in PR #504: PUT /{tenant}/{project}/api/config for provisioning principals; empty body provisions default_project_configuration() (project_key kanbus, same as kbs init); JSON body {configuration} validated (422 invalid_configuration); create-if-absent (409 board_exists); idempotent replay returns 200; response 201 with the config body.
